description: This file defines the TabStops class, a collection managing TabStop objects within a paragraph in the MigraDoc document object model. It includes methods for adding, removing, and querying tab stops, as well as serialization support.

classes.name: TabStops
classes.description: A collection class managing multiple TabStop objects, supporting addition, removal, enumeration, serialization, and style inheritance control.

classes.name: TabStops.TabStopsValues
classes.description: Internal class holding nullable property values for TabStops, used for style inheritance and serialization.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the TabStops collection.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over TabStop elements.

methods.name: GetTabStopAt
methods.description: Retrieves a TabStop at a specific position, considering precision.

methods.name: TabStopExists
methods.description: Checks if a TabStop exists at a specific position.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds or replaces a TabStop at a given position.

methods.name: AddTabStop
methods.description: Adds a TabStop at a position with specified alignment and leader.

methods.name: RemoveTabStop
methods.description: Marks a TabStop at a position for removal.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all TabStops from the collection.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TabStops collection into DDL format.

methods.name: IsNull
methods.description: Determines if the collection is null or empty.
